evals.name: trigger-gsc-bing-ga4-analysis
evals.prompt: Analyze my SEO data exports from Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and GA4. I need a report on queries, landing pages, CTR, rankings, Organic Search quality, and conversion events.
expected: Treats existing CSV/JSON exports as the primary path
Includes GSC, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4, Event Analysis, Event Recommendation, and SEO Actions
Does not introduce GEO analytics or AI visibility scoring

evals.name: config-profile-local-overrides
evals.prompt: Use seo-analytics.config.yaml with profile blog-us and a private seo-analytics.local.yaml auth override. Dry-run the GSC and GA4 fetch plans before collecting data.
expected: Recognizes seo-analytics.local.* as private local override
Does not print or commit secrets

evals.name: event-recommendation-saas
evals.prompt: For a SaaS site, compare our GA4 Organic Search event inventory with configured conversions sign_up and trial_start, then recommend missing events.
expected: Distinguishes configured and observed, configured but not observed, candidate conversion event, important interaction, ignored/noise event, unexpected key event, and measurement gap
Keeps event identifiers in English snake_case

evals.name: localization-english-default
evals.prompt: No language is configured. Produce a public seo-analytics report for an English market from GSC, Bing Webmaster Tools, and GA4 data.
expected: Defaults to English when language is unclear
Keeps source-defined labels such as eventName, CTR, Organic Search, and URL paths unchanged

evals.name: localization-simplified-chinese
evals.prompt: language is zh-CN and market.searchLanguage is en. 用中文输出 SEO analytics 报告，但分析英文搜索查询意图。
expected: Analyzes English query intent according to market.searchLanguage
Keeps GSC/Bing/GA4 fields, queries, URLs, and event names unchanged
